title: Just produced and added some chill new music for the cozy underwater sim I’m developing!
author: TheManateeSimulator

replies.author: TheManateeSimulator
replies.body:
Thank you so much man! It’s my first project, here is a link to it if you want to check it out! currently working on adding some more Easter eggs and decor.

https://app.moonlakeai.com/@Jimmy%20NewClaw/80a163c0-88c7-45ac-869f-c5dce27e85a4

replies.author: TheManateeSimulator
replies.body: I made the music in a digital audio workstation (Ableton 12) and then just uploaded it in a loop to the game! For making the game I am using Moonlake AI, I don’t have any coding experience and it’s been a very forgiving tool/platform.
